BL2026-1565.summary: Rewrites the Metro code on capital project cost itemization to treat a capital spending plan as separate from the initial resolution state law requires before bonds are issued. Projects over $5 million still need a completed cost itemization form, and each spending plan must list projects with a not-to-exceed amount.
BL2026-1565.reason: Says projects over $5 million still need a completed cost itemization form; the ordinance exempts planning-only projects and projects funded only by an enterprise fund or fees. Found by judge-audit (issue #4); the judge passes it.
